newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO to halt test-run of reactor due to odd noise.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO to halt test-run of reactor due to odd noise.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Wednesday it would halt operations of a 1.36 million kilowatt nuclear power reactor in northern Japan because of unidentified sounds coming from within the system.
"It sounds like some kind of metal object hitting another metal object," a TEPCO spokesman said.
The unusual sounds came from near one of the low-pressure turbines, the spokesman said.
The reactor, due to start commercial operations in July, had been operating on an experimental basis.
The unit, the seventh reactor at the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant on the Sea of Japan coast, is expected to come to a complete halt at 8.30 p.m.(1130 GMT).
TEPCO will start investigating the cause of the problem after the reactor has stopped, the spokesman said.
There was no radiation leakage at the plant, he added.
